<summary>📝 Walkthrough</summary>

## Walkthrough

A new `.PHONY` make target `verify-ci-build-times` is added to `Makefile-test.mk`. It invokes `prow_runtimes.py` with fixed arguments targeting kueue presubmits, limiting to 5 builds, filtering for successful merge-pool runs, and enforcing a `second_longest` threshold of `18m`.

## Changes

**CI Build Time Verification Target**

| Layer / File(s) | Summary |
|---|---|
| **verify-ci-build-times make target** <br> `Makefile-test.mk` | Adds a `.PHONY` target that calls `prow_runtimes.py --kueue-presubmits --limit 5 --only-success --only-merge-pool --threshold-stat=second_longest --threshold 18m`. |

## Estimated code review effort

🎯 1 (Trivial) | ⏱️ ~2 minutes

## Poem

> 🐇 A target was placed in the Makefile one day,
> To keep the CI builds from going astray.
> With `second_longest` checked at eighteen,
> No slow-poke presubmit goes unseen.
> Hop, hop — the rabbit approves this way! 🕐

</details>
